title: Joe Martin's Hardware store burns 1959
description: In November 1959, Joe Martin’s hardware store was destroyed by fire after he attempted to defrost frozen pipes with a blow torch, resulting in a $50,000 loss. After the retirement of the late James Montgomery, Mr. Martin had purchased the Montgomery hardware business. Following two devastating fires at his premises, he constructed the Handy-Andy store, which he operated until 1964. The building stood two lots north of the present library.
